parameters.formTitle: Send us a certificate of insurance
parameters.formDescription: Drop a PDF below. We will read it and file it against the right vendor.

parameters.jsCode: const out=[];for(const item of $input.all()){const j=item.json||{},b=item.binary||{},headers=j.payload?.headers||[];const h=n=>headers.find(x=>x.name?.toLowerCase()===n)?.value||'';const meta={source:'email',source_ref:j.id||j.messageId||null,from_address:h('from')||j.from||null,subject:h('subject')||j.subject||'',body_text:j.snippet||j.text||''};const keys=Object.keys(b).filter(k=>b[k]?.mimeType==='application/pdf'||(b[k]?.fileName||'').toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf'));if(!keys.length){const body=(meta.subject+' '+meta.body_text).toLowerCase(),portal=/https?:\/\/[^\s]*(portal|secure|share|download|docs)/.test(body);out.push({json:{...meta,preflight_ok:false,reason_code:portal?'NO_ATTACHMENT_PORTAL_LINK':'NO_ATTACHMENT_TEXT_REPLY',reason_detail:portal?'Email contains a download link and no attachment. Not fetched; needs a person.':'Email has no attachment.'}})}for(const key of keys)out.push({json:{...meta,original_filename:b[key].fileName||'certificate.pdf',binary_key:key},binary:{data:b[key]}})}return out;

const out=[];for(const item of $input.all()){for(const [key,attachment] of Object.entries(item.binary||{})){out.push({json:{source:'form',source_ref:item.json.submittedAt||null,original_filename:attachment.fileName||'certificate.pdf',binary_key:key},binary:{data:attachment}})}}return out;

const crypto=require('crypto');const b=$input.item.binary?.data;if(!b)return {json:{...$json,preflight_ok:false,reason_code:'EMPTY_ATTACHMENT',reason_detail:'No binary payload.'}};const buf=await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(0,'data');const bad=buf.length===0||buf.length>26214400||buf.subarray(0,5).toString('latin1')!=='%PDF-';if(bad)return {json:{...$json,preflight_ok:false,reason_code:buf.length===0?'EMPTY_ATTACHMENT':'NOT_A_PDF',reason_detail:'File is not an accepted PDF under the 25 MB limit.'}};const head=buf.subarray(0,4096).toString('latin1');const tail=buf.subarray(Math.max(0,buf.length-4096)).toString('latin1');if(/\/Encrypt\b/.test(head)||/\/Encrypt\b/.test(tail))return {json:{...$json,preflight_ok:false,reason_code:'PDF_ENCRYPTED',reason_detail:'PDF is password-protected. Ask the sender for an unlocked copy.'}};const sha=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex');return {json:{...$json,preflight_ok:true,content_sha256:sha,byte_size:buf.length},binary:{data:b}};

const schema={type:'object',additionalProperties:false,required:['is_certificate_of_insurance','vendor_legal_name','vendor_address','producer_name','producer_contact_name','producer_email','producer_phone','certificate_date','certificate_holder','certificate_holder_address','coverages','description_of_operations','cancellation_notice_wording','extraction_confidence','confidence_reason'],properties:{is_certificate_of_insurance:{type:'boolean'},vendor_legal_name:{type:['string','null']},vendor_address:{type:['string','null']},producer_name:{type:['string','null']},producer_contact_name:{type:['string','null']},producer_email:{type:['string','null']},producer_phone:{type:['string','null']},certificate_date:{type:['string','null']},certificate_holder:{type:['string','null']},certificate_holder_address:{type:['string','null']},coverages:{type:'array',items:{type:'object',additionalProperties:false,required:['type','insurer_name','naic','policy_number','effective_date','expiration_date','each_occurrence','general_aggregate','addl_insd_asserted','subr_wvd_asserted'],properties:{type:{type:'string',enum:['GENERAL_LIABILITY','AUTO','UMBRELLA','WORKERS_COMP','OTHER']},insurer_name:{type:['string','null']},naic:{type:['string','null']},policy_number:{type:['string','null']},effective_date:{type:['string','null']},expiration_date:{type:['string','null']},each_occurrence:{type:['number','null']},general_aggregate:{type:['number','null']},addl_insd_asserted:{type:['boolean','null']},subr_wvd_asserted:{type:['boolean','null']}}}},description_of_operations:{type:['string','null']},cancellation_notice_wording:{type:['string','null']},extraction_confidence:{type:'string',enum:['HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW']},confidence_reason:{type:['string','null']}}};const instructions='You extract structured data from certificates of liability insurance. Transcribe only; never infer. Return dates as YYYY-MM-DD, limits as integers, null for absent values, and copy cancellation wording verbatim. The INSURED is the vendor and the CERTIFICATE HOLDER is separate. If this is not a certificate, set is_certificate_of_insurance false, all other fields null, and coverages empty. An image-only or scanned document cannot be HIGH. Bias toward LOW.';return {json:{...$json,openai_request:{model:'gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17',instructions,input:[{role:'user',content:[{type:'input_text',text:'Extract the certificate data from this document text.

--- BEGIN DOCUMENT ---
'+($json.text||'')+'
--- END DOCUMENT ---'}]}],reasoning:{effort:'low'},text:{format:{type:'json_schema',name:'coi_extraction',strict:true,schema}},max_output_tokens:3000,store:false},extraction_method:'text'}};

const b=await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(0,'data');const prompt='Read this PDF certificate. Return only a JSON object with is_certificate_of_insurance, vendor_legal_name, certificate_date, certificate_holder, coverages (each with type, policy_number, effective_date, expiration_date, each_occurrence, general_aggregate), extraction_confidence, and confidence_reason. Transcribe only; use null when unreadable. A scanned document cannot be HIGH.';return {json:{...$json,openai_request:{model:'gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17',input:[{role:'user',content:[{type:'input_text',text:prompt},{type:'input_file',filename:$json.original_filename||'certificate.pdf',file_data:'data:application/pdf;base64,'+b.toString('base64') }]}],max_output_tokens:2500,store:false},extraction_method:'vision'}};

const parts=($json.output||[]).flatMap(x=>x.content||[]);let raw=$json.output_text||parts.find(x=>x.type==='output_text'||x.type==='text')?.text||'';raw=raw.replace(/^```json\s*|```$/g,'').trim();const ex=JSON.parse(raw);const source=$('Build OpenAI Vision Request').item.json;return {json:{...source,extraction:{...ex,vendor_address:null,producer_name:null,producer_contact_name:null,producer_email:null,producer_phone:null,certificate_holder_address:null,description_of_operations:null,cancellation_notice_wording:null,coverages:(ex.coverages||[]).map(c=>({insurer_name:null,naic:null,addl_insd_asserted:null,subr_wvd_asserted:null,...c}))},input_tokens:$json.usage?.input_tokens||null,output_tokens:$json.usage?.output_tokens||null}};

const response=$json;const content=(response.output||[]).flatMap((part)=>part.content||[]);const raw=response.output_text||content.find((part)=>part.type==='output_text'||part.type==='text')?.text;if(!raw)throw new Error('MODEL_EMPTY');let extraction;try{extraction=JSON.parse(raw)}catch{throw new Error('JSON_PARSE_FAILED')}const source=$('Build OpenAI Text Request').item.json;return {json:{...source,extraction,input_tokens:response.usage?.input_tokens||null,output_tokens:response.usage?.output_tokens||null}};

parameters.query: INSERT INTO dead_letter (source, source_ref, original_filename, content_sha256, reason_code, reason_detail, raw_payload) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb) RETURNING id, reason_code;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.source || 'form', $json.source_ref || null, $json.original_filename || null, $json.content_sha256 || null, $json.reason_code || 'UNKNOWN', $json.reason_detail || 'Intake rejected before extraction.', $json] }}
